name: Packet Wrangler Range Rider
tagline: A read-only watchdog for hosted sites, drafting fixes for your approval
description: Keeps an eye on a hosted setup and reports on four things: uptime, certificate health, how the pages score on web-vitals checks, and whether any content has gone stale. Fixes are written up as proposals rather than applied, and production is never touched without your agreement. Checks run on a schedule.
author: SLamouroux
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
